content:
There are \(2^3=8\) possible length-3 binary color sequences.  
The \(n\) sequences must be pairwise distinct, so \(n \le 8\).

This bound is attainable, for example by coloring the 8 points in cyclic order as  
\[
R,R,R,B,R,B,B,B
\]
which gives the 8 distinct triples:
\[
RRR, RRB, RBR, BRB, RBB, BBB, BBR, BRR.
\]

Thus the maximum \(n\) is

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
